notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at «قالا حدثنا عبيد الله، بهذا الإسناد», so Ubayd Allah and the back-reference close both routes (rule 3)
«حدثنا أبي» is a bare relation: the father of Ibn Numayr is not named in this text
«وجعل التفسير في حديث أبي أسامة من قول عبيد الله» is Muslim's remark that the explanation is Ubayd Allah's own words; it is not a route and is not written
